acceptanceCriteria: Barrier and redo refusals that depend on the intent-branch precondition carry the same repair text as Mutate.
A test asserts the repair text on each refusal path.
body: Found by the V1-0309 lane (claude/v1-0309-lane 96d595f7, 2026-10-09). Mutate refusals carry repair text naming the intent-branch precondition (CTW-V0-002..007, V1-0325), but barrier and redo refusals do not, so an operator who hits them gets no next step.
title: corvint-tasks barrier and redo refusals carry no repair text for the intent-branch precondition (CTW-V0-007)
